title: Duplicate Zeros
summary: Given an integer array arr of a fixed length, duplicate every zero in the array by shifting other elements to the right.
statement: Given an integer array arr of a fixed length, duplicate every zero in the array by shifting other elements to the right. Modify the array in place without returning anything, and ensure no elements beyond the original array's length are altered.
constraints: Duplicate every zero in place while keeping the original fixed length.
Elements shifted beyond the end are discarded.
hints: Work backward so writes never destroy unread values.
Count zeros to locate each value’s virtual expanded index.
Copy values from the end; for zero, step back once more and write its duplicate when in bounds.
Backward virtual indexing is exactly expansion followed by truncation to fixed length.
editorial: Backward virtual indexing is exactly expansion followed by truncation to fixed length.

tests.explanation: With no zeros the array is unchanged.
